title: Storage unit
purpose: Review one freezer or tank: its facts, occupancy, racks and shelves, boxes and history, and reach the actions to change it.
summary: One freezer or tank: its facts, occupancy, racks and shelves, boxes and history.

tasks.title: Find space in the unit
steps: Select [[Free]] under [[Occupancy]] for the whole unit, or select the count for a rack, shelf or box.
Select a position in the list to open its cell in the box grid.

tasks.title: Add racks or shelves
steps: Admin and manager: select [[Add rack or shelf]].

tasks.title: Reuse this layout for another unit
steps: Review the suggested code suffixes in [[Layout recipe]] before saving.

tasks.title: Take the unit out of service
steps: Retire its racks and shelves first, then select [[Retire storage unit]].

good_to_know: The code is fixed and never reused, even after retirement.
Retirement is permanent. The record and its history are kept.
Nominal temperature is a set point, not a measurement. It never blocks storing an item.
Retired boxes are not listed here. Find them in the Boxes list.

sections.title: Storage unit
paragraphs: The nominal temperature is the unit's stated set point in degrees Celsius, not a measurement; it never blocks storing an item. A retired record shows a banner with when it was retired, by whom and the reason. Its Edit, Retire and Move buttons are gone.

items.label: Technology
items.description: How the unit stores material; fixed at creation.

items.label: Created from template
items.description: The template version the unit was applied from, if any.

items.label: Equipment
items.description: Shown when the equipment module is installed. Opens the equipment list filtered to the equipment registered for this unit, with latest readings and levels, due dates and open excursions.

items.label: Set up
items.description: When and by whom the unit was created.

sections.title: Occupancy
paragraphs: Position counts cover positions in active boxes that sit in active racks, shelves and storage units. Retired structure is never counted as capacity. Installed is every such position; Blocked are positions held out of use; Occupied have an item stored in them; Free is installed minus blocked minus occupied. Free positions are not reserved: a position is claimed only when an item is stored in it.
A positive Free count opens available positions in the unit. Counts in the Racks and shelves and Boxes tables open the list for the selected row. A zero count has no link.

sections.title: Racks and shelves
paragraphs: Every rack, tower, shelf and canister in the unit, including retired ones, ordered by path.

items.label: Slot
items.description: Its place in the unit or parent.

items.label: Holds
items.description: Used and total node slots or box slots. Counts active children only.

items.label: Add rack or shelf
items.description: Opens the rack or shelf form for this unit. Admin and manager roles, active unit only.

sections.title: Boxes
paragraphs: Active boxes in the unit only, by rack path then slot. Retired boxes are not listed; find them through the Boxes list with status Active and retired.

sections.title: Actions
paragraphs: Actions are shown to admin and manager roles, and only while the unit is active.

items.label: Edit
items.description: Opens the unit form to change the name, storage class or nominal temperature.

items.label: Save layout as template
items.description: Opens a new template with this unit's active layout, including slot numbers and box grid versions. Review the suggested code suffixes before saving. Applying the template creates empty positions in the new unit.

items.label: Retire storage unit
items.description: Opens the retirement form. Disabled, with the reason beside it, while the unit still has active racks, towers or shelves. Retirement is permanent.

sections.title: History
paragraphs: The newest 50 recorded changes to this record, shown oldest to newest, each with its time, the person and the reason given. Setup entries carry no reason. History cannot be edited or deleted. With more than five entries the panel starts collapsed; select its heading to open or close it.
